caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile or embroidery pattern positioned horizontally in the center of a light beige background. The pattern is predominantly composed of two colors: a muted red and an off-white or light gray. The design consists of two segments aligned side by side; both segments feature a repeating geometric motif that includes large, symmetrical spirals or volutes, each forming a mirror image with a small circular dot at the center above them. These volute shapes are composed of small, square pixels giving a stepped appearance to their curves. The upper and lower borders of the textile are decorated with parallel horizontal lines with rectangular and square shapes, creating a banded effect. In the spaces between the volutes are smaller circular and rectangular designs. The edges of the textile are uneven, with frayed threads visible, especially along the top, left, and bottom edges. The drawing occupies only a small portion of the overall paper, with ample blank space surrounding it, and there is a small orange mark or smudge near the bottom right corner of the sheet.
title: Tyler Coverlet
